subject: english
question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: __**A part of the rural population are migrated**__ to the cities.

options.text: A parts of the rural population has migrated
A part of the rural populations have migrated
A part of the rural population were migrated
A part of the rural population has migrated

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. A part of the rural population has migrated .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"A part of the rural population"**, which is singular.
 
• A singular subject requires a singular verb, so **"has migrated"** is the correct verb form.
 
• The phrase **"are migrated"** in the original sentence is incorrect because it uses the plural verb **"are"** with a singular subject.
 
• Option 4 correctly uses the singular verb **"has migrated"**, making the sentence grammatically accurate.

Correct sentence: *A part of the rural population **has migrated** to the cities*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:** 

 
 
• The verb must agree with the subject in number (singular or plural).
 
• Example: **The team has won the match** (singular subject).
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Using plural verbs with singular subjects or vice versa.
 
• Incorrect verb form leading to grammatical mistakes.
